title: Hezbollah rejects latest ceasefire agreement as Israeli strikes kill 4 in Lebanon

contentText: Hezbollah on Thursday rejected the latest ceasefire agreement between Israel and the Lebanese government, and the militant group demanded a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as more fighting there hampered efforts to end the Iran war. The Hezbollah announcement came as Israeli strikes killed at least four people, according to local authorities, and a UN peacekeeper was killed in the crossfire. FRANCE 24's Renée Davis reports from Beirut, Lebanon.
